problems: Repair of 2026-10-19: all 8 unapplied reviewer fixes applied (Tsingtao/Kiautschou events and Qingdao/Tianjin cell removal in the 1898-1945 keyframes; Ryukyu Domain vassal_start 1872-10 and vassal_end 1879-3; Guam/Wake split with Guam ending 1944-8; northern Sakhalin counterpart moved to far-eastern-republic with a chain to the Soviet Union from 1922-12; Primorye chained russian-republic to 1920-4 and far-eastern-republic to 1922-10; China provinces intersected with Cliopatria's following-year shape and western Henan, Hunan and Guangxi dated from the Ichi-Go page; Boshin War split into Kanto, Tohoku and Ezo). The dossier validates with 0 errors and 17 warnings (15 counterparts without a dossier: republic-of-ezo, far-eastern-republic, manchukuo, mengjiang, east-hebei-autonomous-council; 2 regions with no grid cell, both Wake Atoll).

Eight thin items were also done from pages opened in the repair: East Hebei start 1935-11 and end 1938-2, Mengjiang end 1945-8, Guangdong 1938-10 split from Hainan 1939, Portuguese Timor 1942-2 (confidence 3), the Indochina takeover 1945-3, the Andaman and Nicobar occupation (british-raj, 1942-3 to 1945-8), Attu and Kiska (1942-6 to 1943-5/7), the Bonin annexation (1876, nobody).

Disagreement with the reviewer's fix text: the Hakodate surrender is dated June 1869 (Republic of Ezo page 'Enomoto surrendered on June 26, 1869', Boshin War page 27 June 1869), not 1869-5; the Empire page's May stands alone. Qingdao is also removed from the 1915-1922 keyframes (occupied land is hatched from the ledger), not only from 1924 on.

Cross-dossier readings still needed: tokugawa-shogunate dissolves in 1868-1 and passes its remaining land to the Empire then, while this ledger has the Kanto in contest to 1868-7 and Tohoku to 1868-11 (counterpart tokugawa-shogunate stands for the Northern Alliance); commonwealth-of-australia records the New Guinea fighting as contests, this dossier as an occupation; the Ryukyu vassal pair now mirrors ryukyu-kingdom /ledger/17-18 (months 10 and 3).

The Primorye and northern Sakhalin occupations are chains of starts and ends (the validator pairs by counterpart string); an end/start pair at 1920-4 (Primorye) and 1922-11/1922-12 (Sakhalin) is a change of owner label, not an end of the occupation, as the notes say. A renderer must coalesce them.

Occupation direction: ledger events for Japanese-held foreign land (Micronesia 1914-1920, Qingdao, Primorye, Sakhalin, China, South-East Asia) follow the schema (this state occupies the counterpart's land); the post-1945 events on Japan's own land are owner-first, as the original notes say. The Micronesian cells of 1915-1920 still lie inside the direct keyframe, which makes the direction ambiguous there.
Nineteen pages were opened for the repair against the original budget of 9 for the Empire plus 1-2 for Japan; the page list is in the dossier's sources[] and notes.
